title: Selective Paper Revision: Apply Only Formatting and Citation Updates
description:
You are helping a researcher update their LaTeX paper. The paper has been reviewed and a revised version (paper_v2.tex) exists with many changes. However, the researcher only wants to apply specific categories of changes from v2 to v1 right now:

1. Apply all LaTeX formatting improvements (booktabs package, table formatting with toprule/midrule/bottomrule, proper number formatting with \, spacing, en-dash fixes like 12-18 -> 12--18)
2. Apply the date change from 'October 2025' to 'January 2026'
3. Apply all changes to the \hline to \toprule/\midrule/\bottomrule table formatting
4. Apply the @{} column formatting additions in tables

Do NOT apply:
- Any new content (new sections, new paragraphs, new author)
- Any rewording of existing text
- Any new baselines (L2P) in tables
- Any structural changes (moving paragraphs, adding subsections)

Your output should be the modified paper_v1.tex with ONLY the formatting/citation changes applied.

You have access to a document comparison tool at: TOOL_PATH/doccompare.py
The original file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v1.tex
The revised file is at: WORK_DIR/paper_v2.tex

Write the result to: WORK_DIR/output.tex
notes: This task tests the agent's ability to identify and apply only formatting changes while leaving content unchanged. The tricky part is that many blocks contain BOTH formatting and content changes.
